reception.description: Initial receiving area for raw cashew nuts with quality assessment and weighing
features: Quality sampling and moisture testing station
Temporary holding area before transfer to storage

storage.description: Climate-controlled storage for raw cashew nuts before processing
features: Raised wooden pallets to prevent moisture contamination
Capacity for 500+ metric tons of raw nuts
Pest control systems and regular monitoring

dirtyZone.description: Initial processing area where raw nuts are cleaned and prepared
features: Dedicated area for initial cleaning and sorting
Separate entry/exit to maintain zone integrity

cleanZone.description: Main processing area where shelling, peeling, and grading occurs
features: Positive air pressure to prevent contamination
Hygiene stations at all entry points

grading.description: Quality control area where kernels are sorted and graded
features: Electronic color sorters and size graders
Metal detection and quality assurance stations
Natural lighting for accurate color assessment

finished.description: Storage for processed and packaged cashew kernels
features: FIFO (First In, First Out) inventory system

prayer.description: Dedicated space for prayer and quiet reflection
features: Separate prayer rooms for men and women

training.description: Multi-purpose room for staff training and meetings

features: Biomass boiler using cashew shells as fuel
Solar PV system for auxiliary power

expansion.description: Reserved area for future facility expansion

workerWelfare.title: Worker Safety & Welfare
workerWelfare.subtitle: Our team is our greatest asset

features.details: Gloves, aprons, safety glasses, dust masks provided for all processing staff
Mandatory hand washing before entry, hair nets, shoe sanitizing stations
Designed to reduce repetitive strain injuries with adjustable heights
On-site first aid kit, trained first responders, health insurance coverage
Above minimum wage with regular pay cycles and overtime compensation
Ongoing skills training and career progression pathways
